QuestInfo.name: Mariwaka's Fox Tail Coat
QuestInfo.0: #p9120016# seems to be unsatisfied with just a #t4000066# muffler. What does she want now?
QuestInfo.1: It turns out #p9120016# wants not just a #t4000066# muffler, but a #t4000066# coat. Why does she need a coat in #m801000000#? Oh well... But how are you going to gather up #b400 #t4000066#s#k?\n\n #t4000066# #b#c4000066#/400
QuestInfo.2: You brought #p9120016# 400 #t4000066#s. Fashion is one thing, but wearing a muffler AND a coat somewhere as perennially warm as #m801000000#? That's just odd.

0.0: Hey, aren't you the person who brought me all those #t4000066#s for my muffler? Nice to see you! Thanks to your efforts, I was able to craft the best muffler in the world! But you know what...? Something's missing. I mean, look... Doesn't my outfit seem incomplete? You know what? I think this dress needs not just a muffler, but a matching coat! Don't you think so?
0.1: Gathering #t4000066#s should be a piece of cake for you. Please bring me a whole bunch.

yes.0: You're so nice! Now this coat is a much bigger project than the muffler. Why don't you bring me #b400 #t4000066#s#k?\r\nThat should be enough material for a coat.

no.0: What do you mean, 'no'? Are you going to leave the job half finished?

1.0: Wow, you brought me all 400 #t4000066#s! I guess it really takes a lot of #t4000066#s to make a coat...

yes.0: You're much tougher than you look. Seriously, thank you soooo much for all this! My dream outfit is finally complete! With this dress, paired with my new #t4000066# muffler and coat, I'll be the most elegant lady in town!

item.0: This isn't 400! I need at least 400 to make the coat! Do it right!
